script: Ankylosaurus was covered in bony armor, like a living tank. Plates of bone were set into the skin all across its back. Some of its relatives even had bony eyelids. Its tail ended in a heavy club of fused bone. Scientists think it could swing that club hard enough to break bones. It lived at the very end of the age of dinosaurs, alongside T. rex.
